commit.name: commit
commit.description: Analyze changes and create atomic, conventional commits with intelligent message generation, version management, changelog updates, and quality insights

create-pr.name: create-pr
create-pr.description: Generate and submit pull requests with intelligent title/description generation, automated reviewer assignment, label management, and quality validation

gather-knowledge.name: gather-knowledge
gather-knowledge.description: Analyze codebase, dependencies, patterns, and constraints to build comprehensive technical context for planning or implementation

implement.name: implement
implement.description: Execute code changes following approved implementation plan, including code, tests, and documentation

plan.name: plan
plan.description: Analyze task and create detailed implementation plan with steps, dependencies, and risk assessment

plan-architecture.name: plan-architecture
plan-architecture.description: Create high-level architectural plan covering technology choices, component boundaries, and integration strategy (Phase 1 of tiered planning)

plan-implementation.name: plan-implementation
plan-implementation.description: Create detailed implementation plan with step-by-step tasks, dependencies, and rollback procedures (Phase 2 of tiered planning)

review-code.name: review-code
review-code.description: Perform comprehensive code quality review including standards, security, maintainability, and best practices validation

review-functional.name: review-functional
review-functional.description: Validate feature completeness, acceptance criteria, user experience, and functional requirements alignment with PRD/task specifications

review-plan.name: review-plan
review-plan.description: Validate implementation plan quality, completeness, and feasibility before execution begins

validate-parallel.name: validate-parallel
validate-parallel.description: Run assert and review-code commands in parallel to reduce validation time by ~50%

validate-plan.name: validate-plan
validate-plan.description: Automated pre-review validation to catch missing plan parameters early (reduces review-plan time by 60-70%)
